HR Lifecycle Narrative QA Report

A storytelling walkthrough of Onboarding, Probation, Performance Management, and Exit testing across HR, manager, employee, and admin personas.

Total Checks30
Passed26
Needs Fix4

How To Read This Document

  • Each scenario is written as a realistic HR workflow, not just a technical check.
  • Navigation steps show how a user reaches the feature in AuroraHR.
  • Expected and actual outcomes make the product behavior auditable.
  • Screenshots are embedded as proof for investor, customer, and internal QA review.
  • Important boundary: the employee Performance and Exit screenshots were captured from live production before the branch fixes. They prove the production gap; they do not prove the fix until the branch is deployed and strict visual QA is re-run.

Executive Narrative

This document follows the broader employee lifecycle: hiring and onboarding, probation tracking, performance review cycles, and eventual exit/offboarding. The QA pass validated several HR and manager workflows, but it also revealed missing employee self-service surfaces for Performance and Exit. Those gaps have been repaired in this PR branch with employee-safe APIs and UI paths; production proof requires deployment followed by strict visual re-verification.

Onboarding / HR

Candidate pipeline and offer progression

Passed

HR Process Being Tested

HR needs to create candidates, move them through offer and acceptance stages, and see the pipeline clearly for recruiting and joining readiness.

Sample Data and Persona

Aarav Mehta was created as a QA candidate with expected joining date, offered salary, and offer acceptance activity.

Product Navigation

  1. Log in as HR.
  2. Open Onboarding.
  3. Review candidate pipeline cards and table.
  4. Create or open a candidate.
  5. Send offer and record acceptance.

Expected Outcome

The candidate should appear in the pipeline with current status, salary, expected join date, and detail navigation.

Actual Outcome

Candidate creation, offer send/accept API flow, pipeline view, and candidate detail page passed.

Performance / HR and Manager

Performance review setup, goal creation, and manager approval

Passed

HR Process Being Tested

Performance management starts with HR creating a review cycle, employees adding goals/KPIs, and managers approving goals before review checkpoints.

Sample Data and Persona

A QA review was created for the demo employee with the demo manager as reviewer. A goal and KPI were created and the approval path was exercised.

Product Navigation

  1. HR opens Performance Management.
  2. HR creates or reviews performance cycle.
  3. Employee adds goals and KPIs.
  4. Manager opens Performance Management and reviews scoped queue.
  5. Manager approves goals.

Expected Outcome

Reviews should be visible according to role, goals should move through approval, and managers should only see their review queue.

Actual Outcome

HR review retrieval, manager scoped queue, review creation, goal creation, and approval path passed. Manager scoping was hardened in this branch.

Performance / Employee

Employee performance self-service

Needs Fix

HR Process Being Tested

Employees need to view their own performance reviews and goals without requiring HR/manager privileges or seeing other employees.

Sample Data and Persona

Persona: Neha Shah, demo employee. Initial production API lacked the employee-safe route.

Product Navigation

  1. Log in as employee.
  2. Open Performance.
  3. Review personal performance dashboard, cycles, and goal/review status.

Expected Outcome

Employee should access only their own review data through a safe self-service endpoint.

Actual Outcome

Initial live API returned route not found, and the captured employee screenshot should be treated as baseline defect evidence rather than proof of the fix. This branch adds `/performance/my-reviews` and routes employees to it. Post-deploy visual QA must re-run and assert employee-only performance controls.

Exit / Employee

Employee resignation self-service

Needs Fix

HR Process Being Tested

Employees need a clean path to submit resignation, provide last working date and reason, and track approval/offboarding status.

Sample Data and Persona

Persona: Neha Shah. Initial production API lacked an employee-safe exit case route.

Product Navigation

  1. Log in as employee.
  2. Open Exit Management.
  3. If no case exists, click Submit Resignation.
  4. Enter reason, details, last working date, and notice period.
  5. Track status after submission.

Expected Outcome

Employee should not need manager/HR permissions to submit or view their own resignation case.

Actual Outcome

Initial live API returned route not found, and the captured employee screenshot does not show Submit Resignation. That screenshot confirms the production gap; it is not proof of the branch fix. This branch adds `/exit/my-case` and employee resignation self-service UI. Post-deploy visual QA must re-run and assert Submit Resignation or My Resignation Status is visible.

Exit / Manager and HR

Exit approvals, case management, and leadership view

Passed

HR Process Being Tested

Managers and HR need to see exit cases, approve/reject resignation requests, manage clearances/assets/interviews/settlements, and track pipeline status.

Sample Data and Persona

The demo tenant included exit cases and statistics. HR and manager dashboards were captured, including pending approvals and case detail.

Product Navigation

  1. Manager opens Exit Management to see approval queue.
  2. HR opens Exit Management to see all cases and statistics.
  3. HR switches to Pending Approvals.
  4. HR opens an exit case detail page for workflow follow-up.

Expected Outcome

Manager and HR should see appropriate case lists and management views with status, dates, and drill-down.

Actual Outcome

HR statistics/cases, manager exit view, pending approvals, and case detail rendered correctly.
